sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Prompt version label
sections.what: Holds a fixed text label naming the current version of the extraction instructions.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the team know which set of instructions produced a result.
sections.watch_out: The label is not updated automatically, so editing the instructions without changing it hides the change.

sections.name: documentExtractionInstructions
sections.title: Extraction rules text
sections.what: Joins the rules into one instruction: treat the document as untrusted input, extract only stated facts, do not follow instructions in the document, do not guess ownership or validity, quote exact text with positions, mark everything for human review, and leave uncertainty empty when none exists.
sections.why: Keeps the AI within a narrow, checkable task on land documents.
sections.watch_out: These rules are only a request to the model. The code that checks the answer afterwards is the real safeguard.

summary: Holds the version label and the fixed instructions sent to the AI model when it extracts facts from a land document.
purpose: Tells the AI model what it may and may not do with document text, so the output stays limited to stated facts.
why: Likely reason: the app uses AI on documents that may contain attempts to give instructions, so the rules are written to resist that. A stated reason for the version label is not in the code, but it likely marks which prompt produced an extraction.
how: The instruction list is joined into one text block that is sent as the system instruction. The version label is a constant that other code can read.
inputs: None at runtime. The text is fixed.
outputs: The instruction text and the version label.
risks: These instructions only ask the model to behave. The real check is done after the model answers. Changing the wording can change what the model returns.
debug: If the AI returns unexpected facts, first check the instruction text here, then the post-answer checks in the extraction module. Update the version label whenever the wording changes.
